entries.name: agent-plan
entries.description: Use when creating or revising an implementation plan that may span agents or sessions and needs explicit model routing, context-efficient batches, copy/paste handoffs, or durable progress tracking.

entries.name: ready-player-one
entries.description: Run before executing a batched prompt or complex task. Verifies skill visibility, harness permissions, uv health, and no locked build artifacts. Autofixes safe issues; outputs 'ready' or a NOT READY list with exact remediation steps. Use when the user invokes /ready-player-one or @skill ready-player-one.

entries.name: clean-code-architecture-guards
entries.description: Use when establishing an architectural rule that must survive future sessions — layer boundaries, import direction, state ownership, size tripwires — or when such a rule exists only in prose, review feedback, or comments and has no failing check in CI.

entries.name: clean-code-error-handling
entries.description: Use when designing or changing error handling, or when a repository has inline messages, generic exceptions, duplicate logging, string-parsed failures, scattered error types, or unclear error ownership.

entries.name: python-quality-gate
entries.description: Use before committing any Python change, after implementing or fixing Python code, or as the final check before opening a PR in a Python repository.

entries.name: python-tdd-cycle
entries.description: Use when implementing any new feature or fix in a Python project that uses pytest. Enforces the red-green loop: write failing tests first, confirm they fail, implement, confirm they pass, then run the full suite before committing.

entries.name: run-unit-tests
entries.description: Run a Python project's unit tests in a managed .venv. Creates the venv if missing, installs all test + pre-commit requirements (pytest, pre-commit, ruff, mypy, etc.), runs the full test suite and pre-commit, and (with --fix) repairs any failing tests or pre-commit violations. Use when the user asks to run unit tests, run the test suite, run pytest, check pre-commit, or says 'rut'.

entries.name: update-claude-pricing-doc
entries.description: Use when the user asks to refresh or update Claude API pricing, or when claude-pricing.json is stale (>1 week old). WebFetches the official Anthropic pricing docs page, extracts only per-model token rates, and writes them to output/claude-pricing.json. Cheap and context-light; never invokes the claude-api skill.

entries.name: update-model-routing
entries.description: Use when model-routing.json may be stale, exact Codex or Claude model IDs need verification, or a plan needs current model profiles.

entries.name: query-all-skills
entries.description: List canonical skills published in the shared catalog.

entries.name: install-skills
entries.description: Install catalog-published skills into harness mixing directories.

entries.name: update-skill
entries.description: Revise one canonical skill and republish its catalog-owned artifacts.

entries.name: update-skills-readme
entries.description: Regenerate and verify the canonical skills README and HTML guide.

entries.name: write-skill
entries.description: Create a canonical skill in a declared collection and publish it through the catalog.

entries.name: run-mac-coverage
entries.description: Use when running, validating, or debugging Scout Mac LLVM code coverage on a Mac test runner. Covers getting/installing the latest laika-build-unreal, running the coverage pipeline, verifying generated reports (HTML, LCOV, text, summary), and troubleshooting common failures.

entries.name: unreal-reset-build-env
entries.description: Use when Unreal Engine builds, UGS builds, UBT/UAT/Build.bat/RunUAT.bat/GenerateProjectFiles, UBA, MSBuild, or Visual Studio shell state must be stopped or cleaned before starting a fresh Unreal build on Windows.

entries.name: unreal-ugs-release
entries.description: Use when building, validating, submitting, troubleshooting, or updating UnrealGameSync UGS precompiled editor binaries, PCB archives, BuildGraph Submit To Perforce For UGS flows, no-submit validation, shader worker mismatches, or UGS archive runbooks.

entries.name: jira-human-ticket-create
entries.description: Use when creating Jira tickets intended for human developers, especially when the request includes a title and partial technical context and needs a structured template with minimal follow-up questions.

entries.name: checkin-receipt-create
entries.description: Use when the user asks to write a checkin receipt for a single Perforce changelist, or explicitly invokes @skill checkin-receipt-create with a CL number. Examines the changelist's description, file list, and diffs (not just the submit comment) and writes a structured receipt to Checkins/perforce/.

entries.name: checkin-receipt-range
entries.description: Use when the user asks to backfill or generate checkin receipts for every Perforce changelist in a date range, or explicitly invokes @skill checkin-receipt-range with start and end dates. Drives checkin-receipt-create across all submitted CLs in the window, idempotently.

entries.name: checkin-rollup
entries.description: Use when the user asks to summarize Perforce checkin receipts over a bi-weekly, monthly, or custom window, or explicitly invokes @skill checkin-rollup with a cadence argument. Groups checkin receipts by initiative arc and produces a summary with status-bullet candidates.

entries.name: report-cost-analysis
entries.description: Use when a work receipt needs optional AI token and cost analysis or an efficiency improvement plan, including after report-receipt --show-cost.

entries.name: report-rollup
entries.description: Use when rolling up status reports into a monthly report or an annual performance-review document, when a scheduled monthly-rollup run fires, or when the user invokes /report-rollup with "month YYYY-MM" or "year YYYY".

entries.name: report-status
entries.description: Use when generating a Tue/Thu status report from work receipts, when a scheduled status-report run fires, or when the user invokes /report-status (optionally with an explicit window override like "window 2026-07-07..2026-07-09").

entries.name: report-receipt
entries.description: Use when the user asks to create or update a work receipt, WR, handoff note, status receipt, completion receipt, progress receipt, or explicitly invokes @skill report-receipt; especially when saving analysis, summarizing engineering work, or preserving text verbatim in a receipt.
